messages:
emma-finance: AP ticket AP-11023: FjordStream AS invoice FS-042 (2026-03-15) includes 25% MVA and an unexpected 15% service surcharge line. PO/contract shows net pricing + usage credits from our pricing experiment. Invoice PDF attached. Can finance/legal confirm treatment?
niko-legal: Norway MVA again. Ask FjordStream for their Norwegian MVA number and an official company reg extract. If they were wrong to charge MVA, request a credit note and reissue without MVA.
harper-sales: I ran the pricing experiment with FjordStream integration enabled; we pushed them a 15% promotional pass-through credit to offset usage. They might have applied that as a "surcharge" line by mistake. I'll loop the rep.
emma-finance: Good catch. Action: 1) ask vendor to reissue invoice net of MVA and remove the surcharge OR provide MVA + reg extract showing MVA liability; 2) ask them to apply the pricing-experiment credit as an AP note instead of a surcharge; 3) confirm bank details on reissued invoice.
ap-bot: AP hold placed on FS-042 (reason: VAT/tax dispute + pricing mismatch).
oliver-finance: Approve hold. Do not pay until credit note or valid MVA docs received. Escalate to procurement if no resolution in 10 business days.
procurement: If vendor refuses reissue, procurement will request contract amendment to clarify net pricing and promo credit flow and tag legal.
tax-bot: Vendor master missing field: mva_number and reg_document. Upload docs to clear hold. Also flag any other invoices from FjordStream in last 120 days that charged MVA for review.
emma-finance: Drafted vendor message and template (sending now): please reissue FS-042 without MVA with note "reverse charge / recipient liable" OR provide MVA reg no. + company extract; include credit note ref FS-042 if reissuing; confirm bank details. CC legal/procurement.
harper-sales: I'll nudge their rep; they were responsive last week.
emma-finance: Also noted: this invoice interacts with our pricing experiment crediting. If they reissue net but still show surcharge, AP to apply internal offset and treat promo as vendor credit once docs are in.
niko-legal: Keep place-of-supply reasoning and correspondence in AP ticket for audit trail.
emma-finance: Will update thread when vendor responds. If anyone finds additional FjordStream invoices with surcharge/MVA, flag them here so we can batch credit requests.
